name: ghalint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  setup:
    name: Setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Filter paths
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            workflows:
              - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

  ghalint:
    name: ghalint
    needs: setup
    if: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.matrix != '[]' && needs.setup.outputs.matrix != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run ghalint
        run: |
          curl -sSfL https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint/releases/download/v1.5.1/ghalint_1.5.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          chmod +x ghalint
          ./ghalint
